{{Top|leg|italics=1}}
The '''''Visions of the New Order''''' was a seminal text written by [[Wilhuff Tarkin/Legends|Wilhuff Tarkin]] and served as a basis for [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] [[New Order/Legends|New Order]]. It was an essential tool in the formation of [[Commission for the Preservation of the New Order/Legends|COMPNOR]]-related organizations, such as the [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|Imperial Security Bureau]] and [[CompForce/Legends|CompForce]].
